messages.content: Solve the mathematics question using the provided image. Give a clear final answer at the end. For a multiple-choice question, include the option letter in your final answer.

content.text:
The big equilateral triangle consists of 36 small equilateral triangles which each have an area of $1 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$. Determine the area of $A B C$.
Choices:
A:$11 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
B:$12 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
C:$13 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
D:$14 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
E:$15 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
